member.name: T:NotificationCore.PushNotification
member.summary: A single, provider-agnostic notification: the target device, the user-facing content and an optional data payload. The dispatcher translates this into the APNs or FCM representation based on .
member.remarks: Only the common fields that both APNs and FCM understand are exposed here. When and are both omitted the notification is treated as a silent, data-only delivery (an APNs background push, or an FCM data message) so the receiving app handles it in the background. Prefer the static factory helpers (, , ) for the common cases.
